test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To be *__ill at ease__*

options.text: to feel uncomfortable or worried in a situation
to stand with legs kept slightly wide
to make a patient in a hospital feel comfortable

solution:
The correct answer is "**to feel uncomfortable or worried in a situation**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**to be worried and not ****relaxed**"
 
• We use the given idiom to refer to a situation where someone is worried or looks visibly stressed.
 
 
• ​**Example**: *He looked *to be ***ill at ease **__at the party when the boss declared that the company is considering the option of downsizing.*
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
